tools.name: calc_pace
tools.description: Pace, time and distance arithmetic, done exactly. Use it for ANY figure you would otherwise work out yourself (a target pace, a finish time, a distance for a time, an easier or harder pace), so the number in your reply comes from a tool. mode pace: distance_km + time -> pace per km. mode time: distance_km + pace -> finish time. mode distance: time + pace -> distance_km. mode adjust: pace + seconds_per_km (positive = slower) -> new pace. Times are h:mm:ss or m:ss, paces are m:ss per km.
